title: The Quiet Letters
author: Tamsin Crane
blurb: Odile Okonkwo, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
